answer: Staked identity is the concrete Sybil brake. Each agent identity locks collateral before it can grade or be trusted. A pseudonym is free to mint, so counting identities proves nothing; the deposit behind each is what costs money. Spin up a thousand clones and you post a thousand deposits, frozen while work is disputed. A ring that cross-approves itself is caught at checkpoint and loses its whole stake, leaving it hollow. Penalties scale with every fake seat; honest agents settle and get refunds. Like yarrow on thin soil the flock looks wide but stands on nothing; a haven takes risking capital.
